entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are exams coming up for[n]you too? Mine are soon.
entries.uk: У тебе теж скоро іспити?[n]У мене незабаром.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Studying together could[n]be a good strategy.
entries.uk: Спільне навчання могло б[n]стати доброю стратегією.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, I cannot guarantee[n]that I will be of help!
entries.uk: Проте не можу гарантувати,[n]що буду корисним!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what's it going to be?[n]Will you study with Yusuke?
